sources.title: Digital Atlas of Ancient Life, Isotelus gigas PRI76285
sources.supports: Actual museum fossil scan preview; Ordovician of Oneida County, New York. Body approximately 3 cm, excluding surrounding rock.
sources.rights: Museum reference preview retained privately; no downloaded mesh or copied texture used.

sources.title: Harvard Museum of Comparative Zoology, Trenton Group Isotelus gigas species account
sources.supports: Eight thoracic segments; raised eyes; subtriangular head and tail, weak twelve pygidial axial rings, small individuals may retain genal spines.

sources.title: Atlas of Ordovician Life: Isotelus
sources.supports: Broad axial lobe, prominent eyes, eight thoracic segments; middle to late Ordovician.

sources.title: Hegna and Briggs 2011, Unmineralized exoskeletal morphology of Isotelus: possible cephalic limb differentiation
sources.supports: Rare ventral preservation; tentative smaller cephalic limb pair and axial concentration of pygidial tissues. Abstract only, not precise appendage census.
sources.rights: Facts paraphrased, no abstract or illustration redistributed.
